entities.summary: Cyr Joseph Ulysse Chevalier was a French Catholic priest, bibliographer, and historian who specialized in the European Middle Ages. He is principally remembered for his Répertoire des sources historiques du Moyen Âge and for his critical work on the authenticity of the Shroud of Turin and the Holy House of Loreto.
